params.body:
## What

Inzichten (`/my-insights`) on production drew its block titles and answer numbers in Poppins 700, which reads as black at 16 and 18px, and two of the six block icons (fa-fire, fa-hourglass-half) drew nothing, leaving an empty 20px box in front of the title so the title started further right than the answer under it.

## Why the icons were missing

Not the purge and not the class names: the theme CSS production serves today has `.fa-fire:before` and `.fa-hourglass-half:before`, and so does a local `npm run build`. The cause is the browser cache. The layout linked the purged theme as `style.min.css?v=1.1`, a hand-written version that never changes, while nginx serves it with `Cache-Control: max-age=2592000`. Every deploy rebuilds the file from the blades, but a browser that fetched it before Inzichten existed (fa-hourglass-half first appeared in a blade on 30 September) keeps that copy for 30 days. In a real session on production the page's `style.min.css` came from cache (transfer size 0) with 2,020 rules, no rule for those two icons, and `content: none` on their `::before`.

## Fix

- **Theme cache-buster.** `style.min.css` is versioned on its file time (`?v=<filemtime>`) in `layouts/app`, `layouts/modalApp` and the Passport authorize view, as `custom.min.js` already was. Each deploy that rebuilds the theme gives it a new URL.
- **Weights as tokens.** `--ins-w-regular` 400, `--ins-w-medium` 500, `--ins-w-semibold` 600 in the design-system section. Block title and the answer's number 600, register names 500, everything else 400 (the "Toon meer" button and the empty-state action go from 500 to 400; their colour already marks them). The page heading goes from `font-bold` to `font-semibold`, and the "viewing as" name gets `font-semibold` instead of the browser's default bold.
- **One left edge.** The icon now hangs in the block's gutter, left of the title, out of the flow (`position: absolute; right: 100%`). A block with an icon gets `ins-has-icon`, which widens its left padding to hold it (40px on a phone, 48px from 640px on). Title, answer, registers and meters all start at the same edge, and an icon that does not draw leaves no gap in front of the title.

## Tests

`InsightsKeepTheirRulesTest`:
- `test_three_weights_and_none_above_600`: the weight tokens are exactly 400/500/600; every `font-weight` in the section is one of them; 600 only on `.ins-block-title` and `.ins-answer strong`, 500 only on `.ins-name`; the rendered page has no `font-bold`/`font-extrabold`/`font-black`, no inline weight of 700 or more, and every `<strong>` outside an answer states its weight.
- `test_every_block_icon_is_in_the_served_theme`: reads each `icon="..."` from the insights blades and checks that the built `public/template/css/style.min.css` has `.fas` and a `::before` rule for every one, that the theme link carries `?v=<filemtime>`, and that every block with an icon has `ins-has-icon`. Mutation-checked: dropping `.fa-fire:before` from the built CSS fails it, and so does putting 700 back on the answer.
- `test_the_icon_hangs_in_the_gutter`: the icon is absolutely positioned, and the title is not a flex row with a gap.

The README (rules 3 and 10) and the block component's comment are updated to match.

Locally: InsightsKeepTheirRulesTest, AGarageSeesItsOwnFiguresTest, StylesheetSyntaxTest, TheThemeOverrulesEverySpacingClassTest, QualityRatchetTest and BuildContractTest pass (43 tests), and so does the full suite (2,560 tests, 0 failures). No PHP under `app/` changed.

Screenshots, taken with the production build (`npm run build`, built Vite CSS and purged theme): before (with the stale cached theme reproduced) and after, at 1440 and 390.
params.title: Insights: lighter weights, and icons that survive a stale theme
